newsitem.title: POLAND: Debica wants all 1996 net for dividend.
newsitem.headline: Debica wants all 1996 net for dividend.

text.p: The board of the Polish tyre-maker Debica SA will ask shareholders on May 28 to approve a dividend pay-out equal to the 1996 net profit of 36.39 million zloty, Debica's president said on Monday.
"The board will recommend that all 1996 profits be alloted to dividend," Zdzislaw Chabowski told a news conference.
Debica is 50.7 percent owned by the U.S. Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co.

"Looking at the company's cash position and its future cash flow, we've decided that it was appropriate to return it (the profit) to shareholders as dividend," said Goodyear's deputy president for finance Robert Tieken.
